name: PixForge · Voxel Spark

Set this centered symbol on a dark graphite rounded-square tile with restrained dimensional depth and an elegantly rounded silhouette; keep generous 12% transparent outer padding. Professional creative software identity matching a charcoal and lavender editor interface. Crisp geometric planes, visually precise pixel-inspired construction, beautifully balanced negative space, minimal detail, soft restrained material lighting, high contrast and immediately legible at 24px. No letters, no wordmark, no numbers, no hammer, no tools, no scenery, no extra objects, no border or drop shadow outside the tile, no watermark. Produce a single centered 1024x1024 icon asset with transparent background, not multiple variants.
